prompt: A candid, casual full-body shot of a chic young woman posing inside a brightly lit convenience store or supermarket, framed through the glass door of a red commercial drink refrigerator. She is wearing a short, sleeveless red square-neck mini dress, high-heeled zebra-print sandals, and carrying a small zebra-patterned handbag while holding a folded black-and-white plaid coat over her arm. Her dark hair is styled in a relaxed updo with face-framing strands, and she has visible arm tattoos. The store interior in the background features tiled floors, refrigerated beverage aisles with bright red frames, Coca-Cola signage, and a "CARNES" sign in the background. High-contrast ambient supermarket lighting, soft film grain, casual street-style aesthetic, shot at eye level.

promptZh: 一张抓拍风格的休闲全身照，主角为 时尚年轻女性，拍摄地点位于 灯火通明的便利店或超市，通过红色商用饮料冷柜的玻璃门取景。她身穿 红色短款无袖方领迷你裙，脚踩斑马纹高跟凉鞋，手提一个小型斑马纹手袋，手臂上搭着一件黑白格纹大衣。她留着深色头发，梳成随性的盘发，脸颊两侧留有碎发，手臂上有明显的纹身。背景中的便利店内部设有瓷砖地面、带有亮红色边框的冷藏饮料货架、可口可乐标识以及背景中的“CARNES”招牌。采用高对比度的超市环境光，带有柔和的胶片颗粒感，呈现休闲街拍美学，平视视角拍摄。
